data.title: Making Ten Race
data.description: Practice finding the missing part to make a complete ten frame.

challenges.hint: Look at how many empty spaces are left in the ten frame.
challenges.narration: I put nine counters on the frame. How many more do we need to make ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 9 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Count the empty squares to find your answer.
challenges.narration: There are eight counters here. How many empty spaces are waiting to be filled?
challenges.instruction: There are 8 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Think about your number bonds for ten.
challenges.narration: We have seven counters on the board. How many more to reach ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 7 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Fill the top row and see what is missing on the bottom row.
challenges.narration: Here are six counters. How many more do we need to make a full ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 6 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Half of the frame is full. How many empty spaces are left?
challenges.narration: Five counters are showing. How many more to make ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 5 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.narration: I placed four counters on the frame. How many more are needed to fill it up?
challenges.instruction: There are 4 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Look closely at the empty squares.
challenges.narration: We start with three counters. How many more do we need to make ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 3 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?
